scope: 11 additional SVG conditions; original 13-gene table unchanged
method: Read XML parent:child edge IDs, original tip labels and numeric node labels; canonicalize unrooted splits; read at specified outgroup where present. No new alignment, tree inference or support resampling.
absence_convention: absent means target split/clade is not present, not support zero
duplicate_rule: Two numeric labels on the two sides of the same displayed root edge represent one unrooted split and are counted once.
